company: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation

bear.why: 2027: market drawdown ~20% cuts fee assets (AUC/A, AUM fees), Fed cuts plus a deposit run-off (NIB deposits -$5bn+) cut NII ~8-10%, fee pressure on renewals; an operational/cyber event costs a year of buybacks (payout 60%). Exit P/E 10.1 = own 5-year median (old ROTCE regime).

base.why: 2026 at guidance (revenue +12-13%, expenses +7-8%, NII +15%) and consensus 9.43; 2027 NI +5.8% (after ~$89M/yr Series O preferred dividends) lands EPS at consensus ~10.44; then fee growth ~6%, NII low single digits, positive operating leverage fading. Payout 88% keeps Tier 1 leverage in the 5.5-6.0% band with ~4% balance-sheet growth. Exit P/E 12.3 = median forward P/E of the last 24 months (the ROTCE ~26-30% regime).

bull.why: Beat record (EPS above consensus 8 of 8 recent quarters, avg ~+9%) continues; platform model keeps ~2 pts/yr operating leverage, digital assets/tokenization and corporate trust add fees. Exit P/E 14.5 ~ today's 14.6x FY27.

calibrated.why: base path, today's forward P/E (price / base 2027 EPS) held as exit multiple

notes.method: Bank/custody: lean_model's FCF DCF does not fit (deposits are raw material, not debt; capital is regulatory). Value = average of (1) residual income on tangible common equity and (2) exit P/E x next-year EPS plus distributions, both on total common equity / shares. Preferreds are outside TCE; NI is to common after preferred dividends.
notes.tce: TBVPS $32.22 x 672.898M shares at 30.9.2026 (3Q26 release, p.6). End-2026 TCE = TCE_Q3 + Q4 NI - Q4 dividends - Q4 buyback ($1.0bn assumed, Q3 was $937M).
notes.rf_erp: 4.9% / 4.2%: same market prices of risk as the 6-9.11.2026 runs (UBER, V)
notes.capital: CET1 10.9% vs requirement 8.5% (4.5 + SCB 2.5 + G-SIB 1.5); Tier 1 leverage 5.7% vs management range 5.5-6.0% (Q3 call). Payout 85-90% is the binding constraint; YTD payout 86%.
notes.preferred: Preferred $4.26bn at 30.9.2026 (XBRL) + Series O $1.25bn issued 28.10.2026 at 7.125% (~$89M/yr dividends), deducted before common earnings.
notes.dilution: Net share count fell 688.2M -> 672.9M in 9M 2026 while ~21M were bought back: ~6M/yr issued to employees (sbc_issuance_m).
